map.MAC 地址共 48 位（6 字节），前 24 位为 OUI（厂商识别码），后: A MAC address is 48 bits (6 bytes): the first 24 bits are the OUI (vendor identifier) and the last 24 bits are the device serial number
map.Organizationally Unique Identifier，由 IEE: Organizationally Unique Identifier, assigned by the IEEE registration authority
map.第 1 字节的第 2 位（U/L bit）为 1 表示本地管理地址: The second bit of the first byte (the U/L bit) being 1 indicates a locally administered address
map.第 1 字节的最低位为 1 表示组播地址: The lowest bit of the first byte being 1 indicates a multicast address
map.现代设备（iOS 14+/Android 10+）会使用随机 MAC 进行隐私保: Modern devices (iOS 14+/Android 10+) use randomized MACs for privacy protection

map.`3C:5A:B4` → 查表得对应厂商（如某网络设备商）；无记录则显示未知。: `3C:5A:B4` → the table gives the corresponding vendor (e.g. a networking equipment maker); if there is no record, it shows unknown.
map.查不到一定假吗？: Does "not found" always mean the address is fake?
map.不一定，小厂商或未登记 OUI 也会查不到。: No. Small vendors or unregistered OUIs will also come up empty.
map.为什么同一个 MAC 查不到厂商？: Why can a given MAC have no matching vendor?
map.常见原因：该地址是本地管理地址（由操作系统或虚拟机随机生成，第 1 字节第 2: Common reasons: the address is locally administered (randomly generated by the OS or a virtual machine, with the second-lowest bit of the first byte set to 1) and belongs to no vendor; the device uses a newer OUI that has not been indexed yet; or it falls in a reserved range used by virtualization software. A miss does not mean the address is invalid.
